decisive_items: A lateral flow COVID-19 antigen test and confirmatory RT-PCR were both positive
a 1-week history of escalating behavioral changes
He denied head injury, substance use, or stressors and had no family history of psychiatric illness
response.rationale: Confirmed COVID-19 with acute new-onset psychosis and no prior psychiatric history favors infection-related psychosis; mercury exposure is only potential and lacks characteristic toxicity signs, while schizophrenia is less likely with abrupt onset and concurrent infection.

rejected.why: Psychotic features are present, but acute 1-week onset, visual hallucinations, and confirmed COVID-19 make an infection-related psychosis more likely than schizophrenia.
